name: cd-company-formation
description: Prepare a DR Congo company-formation and entity-choice research file for 2026 using the OHADA companies act and official Congolese administrative pages. Use this Guide for SARL, SA, SAS, foreign branch, registered office, capital subscription and payment, RCCM and post-formation tax or employer registration questions. It distinguishes legal personality from a submitted application and separates SARL and SA paid-up rules. Two cases recompute a SARL capital schedule and an SA funding decision. National SARL capital/form exceptions, current GUCE instructions, disputed registration handoffs, fees, currency conversion and authenticated completion remain held. The output is a documented formation checklist and conditional capital workpaper, not approval to incorporate, operate a regulated activity or report a completed registration.
